title: Sociocultural Norm Similarities and Differences via Situational Alignment and Explainable Textual Entailment
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its findings focus on cross-cultural differences in social norms related to relational determinism, family discord, intimacy, and trust.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any specific aspect of faith or religion. It focuses on comparing general descriptive social norms between American and Chinese cultures. The term 'authority worship' is mentioned in the literature review as a social orientation in Chinese society, but it is not a focus of the measurement.
